---
title: "OSA_aoi_map"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(tmap)  
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
# library(spData)
# library(spDataLarge)
```

```{r}

# area of interest (aoi)
aoi <- vect(here("00_data", "data_selection", "Amistosa_climate_hub_32617.shp"))

ldc <- rast(here("00_data", "data_selection", "landcover_10_2023_32617.tif"))


elv <- rast(here("00_data", "data_selection", "elevation_30_32617.tif")) |>
  mask(aoi)

pairs_poly <- vect(here("00_data", "data_selection", "plots_poly_32617.shp")) |>
  centroids()
# adding a categorical value, to use it for the legend of our map
pairs_poly$type <- "Pair location"
pairs_poly
base <- vect ("D:/Downloads/world-administrative-boundaries.geojson")
# --------------------------------------
# Recalssify LULC
rcl <- matrix(c(
  110, 110, 10,
  12, 12, 11,
  60, 60, 30,
  90, 90, 80
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

ldc <- classify(ldc, rcl)

levels(ldc) <- data.frame(
  ID = c(10, 11, 13, 30, 50, 80, 95),
  landcover = c("Forests", "Palm plantations", "Pineapple", "Open land", "Build-up", "Water and wetlands", "Mangrooves"))


```

Check this tutorial for inforamation on creating maps with t_map: <https://r.geocompx.org/adv-map#fig:layout1>

```{r}

# Control the bounding box for whcih the map will be desplayed
bb <- st_bbox(aoi)

bb_expanded <- bb
bb_expanded["xmin"] <- bb["xmin"] - 10000   # shift/expand left, units are in meters
bb_expanded["xmax"] <- bb["xmax"] + 20000
bb_expanded["ymin"] <- bb["ymin"] - 5000
bb_expanded["ymax"] <- bb["ymax"] + 5000

# --------------------------------------------------

# tm_basemap("CartoDB.PositronNoLabels") +
tm_shape(base) +  
  tm_polygons() + 
  
tm_shape(elv)+ 
  tm_raster( col.legend = tm_legend(position = tm_pos_in("right", "bottom"))) +
  
tm_shape(aoi) + 
  tm_borders() +

tm_shape(pairs_poly) +
  tm_dots(col = "type",
          col.legend = tm_legend(title = "",
                                 position = tm_pos_in("right", "bottom"))) +
tmap_options(bbox = st_bbox(bb_expanded)) +
  # tm_layout(bg.color = "lightblue")
tm_graticules(alpha = 0.5, n.x = 4, n.y = 4) +
  tm_layout(legend.text.size = 0.5, 
          fontfamily = "Arial"
          )+
tm_scalebar(position = tm_pos_in("right", "bottom"), 
              breaks = c(0, 15, 30))
#+
#tm_scalebar(breaks = c(0, 25, 50), text.size = 0.7)
   


# c(
#     -4, 300, 1,
#     300, 600, 2,
#     600, 900, 3,
#     900, 1200, 4,
#     1200, 1500, 5,
#     1500, 1800, 6
#     )
```

# # --------------------------------------------------
# 
# points for annotation
countries <- data.frame(
  label = c("Costa Rica", "Panama"),
  lon = c(-83.65, - 82.7),
  lat = c(9.24, 9.2)
) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

countries <- st_transform(countries, 32617)
# -----------------------------------------------

# tmap_mode("plot")

tm_shape(base) +  
  tm_polygons() + 
tm_shape(elv)+
  tmap_options(bbox = st_bbox(bb_expanded)) +
  tm_raster(palette = terrain.colors(7),
            breaks = c(0, 300, 600, 900, 1200, 1500, 1800, Inf),
            title = "Elevation (m)") +
tm_shape(aoi) +
  tm_borders() +
tm_shape(pairs_poly) +
  tm_dots(col = "type",
          col.legend = tm_legend(title = "")) +
  tm_graticules(alpha = 0.5, n.x = 4, n.y = 4) +
  tm_scalebar(breaks = c(0, 15, 30))+
  tm_layout(
   legend.position = tm_pos_in("0.78", "0.46"),
   scalebar.position = tm_pos_in("0.73", "0.08"),
   legend.text.size = 0.5, 
   legend.title.size = 0.5,
          fontfamily = "Arial") +
  tm_shape(countries) +
  tm_dots(alpha = 0) +
  tm_text("label", size = 0.8, fontfamily = "Arial") +
  tm_credits(
    text = "a",
    position = c("LEFT", "TOP"),
    size = 2.0,
    fontfamily = "Arial",
    fontface = "bold"
  )

elv

#   ---------------------------------------------


# ----------------------------------------------------

tm_shape(base) +  
  tm_polygons() + 
tm_shape(ldc)+
  tm_raster(
    style = "cat",
    palette = c(
      "Forests" = "#307800",
      "Open land" = "#ffe699",
      "Water and wetlands" = "#00b0f0",
      "Build-up" = "#f62024",
      "Palm plantations" = "#c80094",
      "Pineapple" = "#f4b084",
      "Mangrooves" = "#00f4c6"),
    title = "Land cover")+
  tmap_options(bbox = st_bbox(bb_expanded)) +
tm_shape(aoi) +
  tm_borders() +
tm_shape(pairs_poly) +
  tm_dots(col = "type",
          col.legend = tm_legend(title = "")) +
  tm_graticules(alpha = 0.0, n.x = 4, n.y = 4, labels.col = 'white') +
  # tm_scalebar(breaks = c(0, 15, 30))+
  tm_layout(
   legend.position = tm_pos_in("0.73", "0.38"),
   # scalebar.position = tm_pos_in("0.73", "0.08"),
   legend.text.size = 0.5, 
   legend.title.size = 0.5,
          fontfamily = "Arial") +
  tm_shape(countries) +
  tm_dots(alpha = 0) +
  tm_text("label", size = 0.8, fontfamily = "Arial") +
  tm_credits(
    text = "b",
    position = c("LEFT", "TOP"),
    size = 2.0,
    fontfamily = "Arial",
    fontface = "bold"
  )
#----------------------------------
tmap_arrange(elv, lulc)
